chunks: And from a letter of him (peace be upon him) to al-Mundhir ibn al-Jarud al-Abdi
who had misappropriated certain things given into his administrative charge.
ai.seo_question: Who was al-Mundhir ibn al-Jarud and what was his administrative failure?
ai.summary: This letter from Imam Ali (AS) to al-Mundhir ibn al-Jarud addresses the specific failure of an appointed administrator who misappropriated state resources, highlighting the principle of *amanah* (trust) in governance. It serves as a key example in Shia political thought of the Imam's direct accountability of officials, emphasizing that administrative power is a divine trust rather than a personal right. The narration underscores the moral and practical necessity of integrity in public office, linking administrative duty to spiritual accountability.

en.sayed-ali-raza: who had misappropriated certain things given into his administrative charge.
